description: Wire wizard entry points into __main__.py CLI, add 'run without asking' settings UI, and create desktop/MIME integration files. Completes wizard integration with application launcher and file manager.
steps: Modify src/aurelis_software/__main__.py: replace 'wizard install|uninstall are Phase 7; not yet implemented' stub with actual wizard dispatch logic

In __main__.py, parse 'wizard install <path>' subcommand: build AppImageBackend (with DbusClient from session bus), load Paths and Config, instantiate InstallWizard(path, backend, config, paths), call wizard.exec(), return 0 if accepted else 2. Skip catalog loading and main window creation.

In __main__.py, parse 'wizard uninstall <path>' subcommand: build backends dict with AppImageBackend, FlatpakBackend (if flatpak available), PacmanBackend (if pkg available), load Paths and Config, instantiate UninstallWizard(path, backends, config, paths), call wizard.exec(), return 0 if accepted else 2
Modify src/aurelis_software/ui/settings_dialog.py: add new QGroupBox 'Wizards' section after existing groups

In settings_dialog.py Wizards section, add QLabel 'Run without asking:' and QListWidget showing entries from config.get('wizard.run_without_asking', []). Each list item displays app_id (filename) and has a QPushButton 'Remove' in item widget.
Wire Remove button in settings_dialog.py to pop entry from config['wizard']['run_without_asking'] list, call save(paths, updated_config), and refresh QListWidget
Create src/aurelis_software/resources/ directory if it does not exist

Create src/aurelis_software/resources/aurelis-software-wizard-install.desktop with keys: Type=Application, NoDisplay=true, Name=Aurelis Software Install Wizard, Exec=aurelis-software wizard install %f, MimeType=application/vnd.appimage;application/vnd.flatpak.ref;application/vnd.flatpak;, Icon=system-software-install

Create src/aurelis_software/resources/aurelis-software-uninstall.desktop (Dolphin service menu pattern) with keys: Type=Service, ServiceTypes=KonqPopupMenu/Plugin, MimeType=application/x-desktop;application/vnd.appimage;, Actions=uninstall;, [Desktop Action uninstall] section with Name=Uninstall with Aurelis Software, Icon=edit-delete, Exec=aurelis-software wizard uninstall %f
Create tests/wizards/test_desktop_files.py with test that runs subprocess.run(['desktop-file-validate', path]) for both desktop files and asserts returncode == 0
acceptance_criteria: __main__.py wizard install subcommand creates InstallWizard and shows it without loading catalog
__main__.py wizard uninstall subcommand creates UninstallWizard with all available backends
settings_dialog.py Wizards section displays run_without_asking entries with Remove buttons
Remove button in settings deletes entry from config and saves immediately
Both desktop files have correct Exec= entries pointing to aurelis-software wizard subcommands
verification: Run pytest tests/wizards/test_desktop_files.py -v and confirm desktop-file-validate passes for both files
Run python -m aurelis_software wizard install /tmp/test.AppImage (with fake file) and confirm InstallWizard appears (manual UI check or offscreen test)
Run ruff check src/aurelis_software and confirm no violations
